command:
set -eu
mkdir -p /tmp/home
trap 'cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.events > /work/output/memory-events.txt; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.peak > /work/output/memory-peak.txt' EXIT
rustc -Vv > /work/output/rustc.txt
cargo fmt --all --check > /work/output/fmt.log 2>&1
cargo clean -p recalld > /work/output/package-clean.log 2>&1
cargo test --offline --locked --all-features --lib bench::frozen::tests -j 1 -- --nocapture > /work/output/focused.log 2>&1
cargo test --offline --locked --all-features --lib storage::ids::tests -j 1 -- --nocapture > /work/output/ids.log 2>&1
cargo test --offline --locked --all-features --lib owned_ids_actual_native -j 1 -- --nocapture > /work/output/native-ids.log 2>&1
cargo test --offline --locked --all-features --lib native_terminal_uuid_reuse -j 1 -- --nocapture > /work/output/terminal-id-regression.log 2>&1
cargo build --offline --locked --example owned_evaluator --features bench -j 1 > /work/output/example-build.log 2>&1
python3 scripts/test_owned_evaluator.py --binary /work/target/debug/examples/owned_evaluator --output /work/output/controls > /work/output/controls.log 2>&1
python3 scripts/test_owned_reset.py --binary /work/target/debug/examples/owned_evaluator --output /work/output/reset > /work/output/reset.log 2>&1
cargo test --offline --locked --all-features --lib --bins --tests --examples -j 1 > /work/output/full-suite.log 2>&1
cargo clippy --offline --locked --all-features --all-targets -j 1 > /work/output/clippy.log 2>&1
cargo build --offline --locked --bin recalld -j 1 > /work/output/bin-build.log 2>&1
python3 scripts/public-conformance.py --inside --fixture-version 3 > /work/output/public.log 2>&1
python3 scripts/test_public_conformance.py > /work/output/runner-tests.log 2>&1
